_provenance.notes: Commercial fishing fleet size reflects the number of vessels and permit holders actively participating in Alaska fisheries. Limited entry (CFEC, 1975) was designed to reduce fleet size to economically optimal levels. IFQ programs for sablefish/halibut (1995) and groundfish rationalization (CDQ 1992, AFA 1999, crab rationalization 2005) further reduced fleet size while improving economics per vessel.
